reasoning: The package is a standard binary packaging of an Electron application. The PKGBUILD downloads a pinned RPM with verified SHA256 checksums from the vendor's Aliyun OSS bucket. The auxiliary scripts (qoder-cn-ide.sh, qoder-cn-ide.js) are standard Electron launchers. No malicious injection, obfuscated code, or suspicious behavior was found in any of the packaging files.
disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from tool and parsing errors rather than actual security findings. The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 error when auditing qoder-cn-ide.js, and the openrouter model failed to parse its response for the same file, resulting in inconclusive verdicts. The deepseek model successfully audited all files, including qoder-cn-ide.js, confirming it is a benign Electron launcher.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit qoder-cn-ide.js due to an HTTP 400 API error.
openrouter model failed to parse the audit decision for qoder-cn-ide.js.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for individual file audits when an LLM API call fails or returns an unparseable response, rather than failing the entire package audit.
Ensure that a single file's audit failure does not automatically downgrade the entire package verdict to inconclusive if the failure is clearly a transient API or parsing error.
